0.heading: Overview
refs: Psa 132:1 , David in his prayer commends unto God the religious care he had for the ark
Psa 132:8 , His prayer at the removing of the ark
Psa 132:11 , with a repetition of God's promises.
Some attribute this Psalm to Solomon
and others refer it to the building of the second temple
but it seems more probable that it was sung at the solemn induction of the ark into the tabernacle of Mount Zion, expressing the holy joy and triumph of that event.
0.body:
